Issue also says "keep the restriction limited to executable automation assets; preserve existing rejection reasons and default-allow behavior".
  Expected change site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` `_rb_fix_scope_is_protected` predicate and the `RB_FIX_SCOPE_REJECTED_PATHS` accumulation logic.
  Evidence of absence: The PR's main scope-locked fix (extending `_rb_fix_scope_is_protected` to include `workflow-templates/*` and routing the `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=false` check through the predicate via the `*)` wildcard at lines 21460-21506) is present. These renames change what the test asserts about pre-existing fork-head-rejection paths and are not mentioned in issue #6390, the PR description, or the linked AI Issue Summary ("Extend the opt-out and protected-path checks ... Keep the restriction limited to executable automation assets; preserve existing rejection reasons and default-allow behavior"). Bundling an unrelated reason-string refactor with the security fix is scope creep: the "preserve existing rejection reasons" requirement of the linked issue is at risk if this rename actually applies to a path that still emits `head_repo_mismatch` (the post-judge recheck path emits `head_repo_mismatch`, not `cross_repository`).
